visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male host with short black hair is seated in a well-lit studio office environment, dressed in a professional black jacket over a checkered shirt. He faces the camera behind a desk with a laptop. A cartoon head overlay represents an off-screen interviewer. (2) A sharp cutaway displays white liquid milk being poured into a bowl containing a beige powdered substance, illustrating the historical use of nutritional supplements. The background is a clean, neutral surface, emphasizing the physical texture of the food items being described by the host. (3) The scene shifts to a misty, dense forest where two individuals dressed in full camouflage hunting attire are crouched, aiming rifles into the distance. This visual serves as a metaphor for the post-war economic conditions and resource scarcity mentioned in the ongoing narration. (4) The host returns to the screen, using active hand gestures to explain the government's historical implementation of child nutrition programs using UNICEF supplies. His facial expressions are animated, shifting between informative and engaging while maintaining direct eye contact with the viewer. (5) A cutaway shows a female volunteer with vibrant purple hair at a community pantry station labeled "FREE FOOD." She is meticulously organizing canned goods, cardboard boxes, and clear water bottles on a table, representing the arrival of foreign aid and food distribution efforts. (6) Large, round white steamed buns (mantou) are shown moving on a bright blue industrial conveyor belt inside a clean production facility. The camera captures the repetitive motion and soft texture of the buns, highlighting the shift toward flour-based diets in the 1960s. (7) A young boy with dark curly hair is shown in a brightly lit kitchen, taking a bite of a cracker while holding a glass of milk. The setting is warm and domestic, featuring kitchen utensils and a blurred background that conveys a sense of improved nutrition. (8) Close-up of a pair of hands wearing purple rubber gloves washing a white ceramic plate under a steady stream of water from a chrome faucet. The scene emphasizes the educational aspect of school lunches, focusing on the development of hygiene and cleaning habits. (9) The host leans forward aggressively with a wide-eyed, comical expression of fear and shock. Dramatic red and yellow text reading "Tri-color beans" appears over the frame with high-contrast cinematic lighting effects, concluding the video on a lighthearted, humorous note about food.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 歷史老師 真的問什麼 都答得出來嗎. [Slogan]: 歷史老師 真的問什麼 都答得出來嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 什麼時候 開始有營養午餐. (3) [Subtitle]: 最早不是午餐. (4) [Subtitle]: 其實是用 營養奶粉 & 濃湯. (5) [Subtitle]: 最早在1950年代. (6) [Subtitle]: 那時候剛戰後 經濟狀況很差. (7) [Subtitle]: 學童都瘦巴巴的. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以政府就用 聯合國兒童基金會 來幫學童補充營養. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以一開始都只吃奶粉? 一定吃不飽嘛. (10) [Subtitle]: 後來有進化 到了大概1957年 政府開始有美援 開始有所謂的 營養濃湯. (11) [Subtitle]: 裡面就升級 蔬菜都出現. (12) [Subtitle]: 但還是感覺吃不飽啊 慢慢來嘛 1960年代 美援的量開始增加. (13) [Subtitle]: 尤其是麵粉 數量非常非常龐大 政府也推動 麵食運動. (14) [Subtitle]: 饅頭 小麥片 這些東西也開始加入午餐的行列囉. (15) [Subtitle]: 感覺可以吃飽了 1964年 政府也正式推出 學童午餐計劃. (16) [Subtitle]: 讓20萬名學童 每天都有 熱騰騰的午餐可以吃. (17) [Subtitle]: 其實也不只是吃飯 透過營養午餐 飲食教育 也可以放入其中. (18) [Subtitle]: 飯前要洗手 飯後要收拾 這些良好習慣 可以透過營養午餐來養成. (19) [Subtitle]: 哇原來營養午餐這麼多功能 不過不過 有一些很可怕的東西 偷渡在營養午餐裡. (20) [Subtitle]: 萬惡的 三色豆 等一下 什麼三色豆? 這是另外一個故事啦 改天再聊.
